headline: Foreclosed Homes Also Hit by "Mortgage Drought": Total Auction Sale Amount in Q3 of Last Year Hits Single-Quarter Low - Liberty Finance
summary: Nationwide real estate foreclosure auction sales totaled NT$3.542 billion in Q3 2025, the lowest for a single quarter. Mortgage restriction policies were at their tightest then.
why: Foreclosure auction volumes are often watched as a signal of stress in the property market, and mortgage rules shape credit available to homebuyers.
